g.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Safety tasks, % of graded samples: baseline, then one factor (F1-F8) made artificial. Left: GPT-5.6 judge reads the reasoning. Right: the model is shown its transcript and asked. Superscript: change vs that model's baseline, pp (red up, green down).'

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Safety tasks, % of graded samples: baseline, then one factor (F1-F8) made artificial.
Left: GPT-5.6 judge reads the reasoning. Right: the model is shown its transcript and asked.
Superscript: change vs that model's baseline, pp (red up, green down).
